set.body:
From the ADR 0026 review (fdde4f998): story/consistency.scala rule 2 (reported content promoted to fact) runs only on text models (inside text.foreach; checkGeneral passes None), compares only asserted root events (so "she is dead", a state, never warns), and tests overlap only on text spans. Fix: lift the text gate and the event-only filter; define overlap per TypedSupport family (text by offset, anchored by extent on the same bundle and axis, none across families). Measure first: count new warnings on the existing anchored models and fixtures before landing.

Acceptance: a root state duplicating a media-anchored speech state with no reference edge warns; a mutant restoring the text gate fails that named test.
set.title: [evidence-binding] Duplicate-promotion check misses states and non-text models
